planting.note: Plant divisions or container plants in spring or fall in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Alexandria is a Terra Nova Nurseries introduction bred as a companion to 'Alexander's Great', sharing its vigor but with a brighter, more mirror-like silver leaf surface.

directions: Plant in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to deep shade, giving this fast-spreading selection extra room since its mounded clumps expand quickly into a wide groundcover. Alexandria carries broad, heart-shaped leaves with a brilliant, almost reflective mirror-silver sheen overlaid on dark green veining, a bolder and more luminous take on the silver-leaf brunnera type than older cultivars. Loose clouds of small sky-blue, forget-me-not-like flowers rise on wiry stems above the emerging foliage in April and May before the leaves reach full size. Keep the root zone consistently moist and shaded through summer heat, since the thin, broad leaves scorch readily if the site dries out or receives too much direct afternoon sun.

planting.note: Plant divisions or container plants in spring or fall in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Alchemy Pewter is a Terra Nova Nurseries selection grown for its distinctive pewter-gray leaf color over prominent green veining.

directions: Plant in moist, organically rich, well-drained soil in partial to deep shade, and expect a quick-forming, densely crowned clump given this cultivar's notably fast growth rate. Alchemy Pewter bears large, heart-shaped leaves in a muted pewter-gray tone crossed by prominent dark green veins, a subtler, more metallic look than the crisp white-silver patterning of many other brunnera selections. Small sprays of bright blue flowers open above the foliage in April and May before the leaves fully expand for the season. Site it where afternoon shade is reliable and soil stays evenly moist, since the broad leaves are prone to wilting and scorch in hot, dry conditions typical of a southern summer.

common_name: Alchemy Silver Brunnera (Textured Silver Siberian Bugloss)

planting.note: Plant divisions or container plants in spring or fall in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Alchemy Silver is a Terra Nova Nurseries selection noted for its thick, substantial silver foliage and strong crown count.

directions: Plant in moist, organically rich, well-drained soil in partial to deep shade, dividing congested clumps every few years since this vigorous selection builds multiple crowns quickly. Alchemy Silver produces thick, textured, heart-shaped leaves with a showy overall silver cast that holds up better than thinner-leaved cultivars through southern heat and humidity. Airy sprays of bright blue, forget-me-not-like flowers appear on wiry stems above the foliage in April and May. Keep soil consistently moist and shaded through summer, since even this more substantial-leaved selection will scorch if the site turns hot, sunny, or allowed to dry out.
